description: This file defines error handling structures and functions related to GitHub API and GraphQL errors, including context management for error propagation in a Go project.

classes.name: GitHubAPIError
classes.description: Represents an error response from the GitHub API, including a message, response object, and underlying error.

classes.name: GitHubGraphQLError
classes.description: Represents a GraphQL error from GitHub, including a message and underlying error.

classes.name: GitHubErrorKey
classes.description: A unique key type used for storing GitHub error information in context.

classes.name: GitHubCtxErrors
classes.description: Holds slices of API and GraphQL errors for context-based error tracking.

methods.name: newGitHubAPIError
methods.description: Creates a new GitHubAPIError with specified message, response, and error.

methods.name: newGitHubGraphQLError
methods.description: Creates a new GitHubGraphQLError with specified message and error.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the string representation of GitHubAPIError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the string representation of GitHubGraphQLError.

methods.name: ContextWithGitHubErrors
methods.description: Initializes or resets GitHub error tracking in a context.

methods.name: GetGitHubAPIErrors
methods.description: Retrieves GitHub API errors from context.

methods.name: GetGitHubGraphQLErrors
methods.description: Retrieves GitHub GraphQL errors from context.

methods.name: NewGitHubAPIErrorToCtx
methods.description: Creates a new API error, adds it to context, and returns updated context.

methods.name: addGitHubAPIErrorToContext
methods.description: Adds a GitHubAPIError to the context's error slice.

methods.name: addGitHubGraphQLErrorToContext
methods.description: Adds a GitHubGraphQLError to the context's error slice.

methods.name: NewGitHubAPIErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates an error response for API errors, storing error info in context.

methods.name: NewGitHubGraphQLErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates an error response for GraphQL errors, storing error info in context.
